description: This bar chart, titled "Marco-o1-7B", presents two horizontal bar charts side-by-side comparing inference times in minutes for five different methods: Baseline (light green), Fast-Solving Prompt (yellow), SFT (grey), DPO (orange), and O1-Pruner (blue). The left chart displays inference times ranging from approximately 1.1 to 2.2 minutes, while the right chart displays times ranging from approximately 4.0 to 6.0 minutes. In both charts, the vertical axis represents the inference time in minutes, and the horizontal axis represents the different methods, with the bars extending leftward from the vertical axis. The bars are grouped by method, with each method represented by a distinct color. In the left chart, the Baseline method has the longest inference time at approximately 2.2 minutes, followed by SFT at approximately 2.1 minutes, DPO at approximately 1.5 minutes, and O1-Pruner at approximately 1.1 minutes. In the right chart, the Baseline method again has the longest inference time at approximately 6.0 minutes, followed by SFT at approximately 5.9 minutes, DPO at approximately 5.7 minutes, and O1-Pruner at approximately 4.0 minutes. The bars are not sorted in any particular order, and there are no visual emphasis or annotations on any specific bars. The chart does not contain any additional text or legends beyond the method labels at the bottom.
